differentiators.title: Same-Day Crown Technology
differentiators.description: Using CEREC technology, we design and place durable, natural-looking crowns in a single visit, saving you time and multiple appointments.

differentiators.title: Experienced Family Providers
differentiators.description: Dr. Steven Angell brings over 18 years of clinical expertise and hands-on experience in restorative, cosmetic, and family dentistry.

differentiators.title: Flexible Payment Options
differentiators.description: We offer bi-weekly and monthly financing plans and are in-network with all major insurance providers to keep your care affordable.

differentiators.title: Patient-Focused Approach
differentiators.description: Our team is dedicated to stress-free visits, combining a gentle touch with a facility that welcomes every patient like family.

treatmentJourney.title: Welcome and Comprehensive Exam
treatmentJourney.description: Your journey begins with a warm welcome to our state-of-the-art facility, where we perform a thorough exam using digital X-rays and 3D imaging.

treatmentJourney.title: Personalized Care Planning
treatmentJourney.description: Dr. Angell explains every procedure clearly, creating a custom plan that fits your health goals, timeline, and financial needs.

treatmentJourney.title: Preventive Care and Education
treatmentJourney.description: Our hygiene team provides thorough cleanings and guidance to help you maintain a vibrant smile and prevent future dental issues.

treatmentJourney.title: High-Tech Treatment
treatmentJourney.description: Whether you need a filling or a same-day CEREC crown, we use advanced tools to ensure your treatment is fast, accurate, and comfortable.

treatmentJourney.title: Cosmetic and Functional Refinement
treatmentJourney.description: We offer options like whitening, veneers, or dental implants to perfect the aesthetics and function of your unique smile.

treatmentJourney.title: Ongoing Wellness Maintenance
treatmentJourney.description: We provide regular recall visits and long-term support to ensure your dental health remains strong and your smile stays confident for years.

benefits.title: Flexible Financing Plans
benefits.description: We make care affordable with bi-weekly and monthly payment plans, low down payments, and insurance-friendly billing for all families.

benefits.title: Advanced Dental Technology
benefits.description: Experience faster, more accurate results with digital X-rays, 3D imaging, and CEREC same-day crown technology for your convenience.

benefits.title: Care for All Ages
benefits.description: From a child's very first tooth to maintaining senior smiles, our team provides positive dental experiences for every generation.

benefits.title: Multilingual Team
benefits.description: Our friendly, multilingual staff ensures clear communication and a welcoming environment for patients from diverse backgrounds.

benefits.title: Same-Day Emergency Care
benefits.description: We prioritize dental emergencies and make every effort to provide same-day appointments to relieve pain and stabilize your oral health.

benefits.title: Safe and Modern Facility
benefits.description: Relax in a state-of-the-art office featuring HD TVs in every room and safety standards that exceed OSHA and CDC guidelines.

implantOptions.title: Restorative Dentistry
implantOptions.description: Restore strength and function with expertly crafted crowns, bridges, and dental implants that look and feel like your natural teeth.

implantOptions.title: Family and Pediatric Care
implantOptions.description: Comprehensive preventive services including regular checkups and cleanings tailored for patients of all ages, from toddlers to seniors.

implantOptions.title: Cosmetic Smile Makeovers
implantOptions.description: Enhance your confidence with personalized treatments such as professional whitening, veneers, and dental bonding for a radiant result.

implantOptions.title: Emergency Dental Services
implantOptions.description: Fast and compassionate care for urgent needs like tooth pain, infections, or trauma to stabilize your health and provide immediate relief.

faqItems.question: Do you accept my dental insurance?
faqItems.answer: Angell Family Dentistry is in-network with all major insurance providers. We are happy to submit all forms for you to help you maximize your benefits.

faqItems.question: Can I get a dental crown in one day?
faqItems.answer: Yes! With our advanced CEREC technology, we can design, create, and place high-quality, durable crowns during a single appointment.

faqItems.question: Is your clinic good with children?
faqItems.answer: Absolutely. We provide gentle pediatric care including cleanings and education to help kids build lifelong healthy habits in a stress-free environment.

faqItems.question: What financing options do you offer?
faqItems.answer: We offer flexible monthly and bi-weekly payment plans with low down payments to ensure you can afford the treatment you need and want.

faqItems.question: Do you handle dental emergencies?
faqItems.answer: Yes, we prioritize emergency calls and make every effort to see patients on the same day for issues like severe pain or broken teeth.

faqItems.question: Where is your office located and what are your hours?
faqItems.answer: We are located at 423 40th Ave NE #3719 in Minneapolis. We are open Monday through Thursday from 8:00 am to 5:00 pm.

clinic.footerAbout: Angell Family Dentistry has been serving Columbia Heights families since 2008, providing gentle, patient-focused dental care backed by advanced technology and flexible financing.

doctor.name: Steven Angell
doctor.bio: Dr. Steven Angell has been providing high-quality dental care at Angell Family Dentistry since joining the practice in 2008. He earned his undergraduate degree from St. John’s University and his dental degree from the University of Minnesota. An active member of the Minnesota and American Dental Associations, Dr. Angell stays current with the latest advancements through the OMS Study Club. He is passionate about all areas of family dentistry and is dedicated to helping patients achieve healthy, confident smiles.

reviews.name: Dianne Lutz
reviews.text: The team and Dr. Steve are CARING. They are dedicated to excellent dentistry. Dr. Steve is so thorough with explaining the procedure. Angell Dentistry is simply the best!

reviews.name: Shana Jackson
reviews.text: The energy was amazing, you felt at home. You can feel that they care about their patients. They were so friendly, especially with my kids. I am 100% happy with my choice.

reviews.name: James R.
reviews.text: I was impressed with the same-day crown technology. I didn't have to come back for a second appointment, and the fit was perfect. The flexible financing also made it very easy.
